headline: The Biggest Mistakes People Make with Smoke Damage
articleBody: When dealing with smoke damage, it's easy to make a few common blunders that can actually make the problem worse or prolong the smell. One big mistake is simply painting over smoke-damaged walls without proper cleaning and sealing – the odor will just seep right back through. Another common error is using household air fresheners or candles; these only mask the smell temporarily and don't actually remove the smoke particles. Trying to clean everything with water without understanding the type of smoke (wet vs. dry) can spread soot and embed the smell further. People often forget to clean out their HVAC systems, which can continuously blow smoky air throughout the house, or neglect porous materials like drywall and upholstery where odors absorb deeply. Finally, underestimating the extent of the damage is a huge one. Smoke travels everywhere! To avoid these pitfalls and ensure a complete cleanup, especially after a significant fire, it’s best to consult with experienced professionals.
